note: Colour tokens of the nyx window (ADR 88, proposed), merged from the two UX mockup sets and corrected after the comparison of 2026-11-17. Every text and edge pair is checked by the contrast test described in docs/ux/UX_MERGED_PLAN.md; every data palette by the dataviz validate_palette.py with --pairs all. Source of today's values: crates/app/src/theme.rs.

raised.use: hover and pressed neutral fills, popups

separator.use: dividers and card outlines only; never a control edge

control_edge.use: edge of buttons, fields, combo boxes, checkboxes (>= 3:1); High contrast raises it to >= 4.5:1

control_edge_high.use: the control edge when Settings says High contrast (>= 4.5:1 on page, card and raised)

muted.use: secondary text (>= 7:1 on page and card in light, 6.2:1 on raised in dark)

accent.use: the brand colour: primary action fill, links, focus ring, selected bar. These are today's values (theme.rs PLUM and the dark pink); only the text on them changes

on_accent.use: text on an accent fill (white on the dark pink is 3.21:1 and fails; ink is 5.62:1)

tint.use: selected item background (with a 2 px accent bar)

activity.use: running, queued, stale: fill, text on it is on_activity

activity_text.use: activity colour used as text; light needs the dark amber on activity_tint

activity_tint.use: background of the busy chip and stale band

success.use: saved, converged, passed (always with a glyph and a word)

danger.use: failed, destructive (always with a glyph and a word)

canvas.use: viewport and plot background. DEFAULT: dark in both themes (decision D2, Paul 2026-11-17); Settings offers 'follow the theme'

chip.use: region number chip background: the canvas colour of the same mode, with 'text' on it (14.3:1 dark, 15.8:1 light), so the chip does not depend on the region colour

region_grey.use: fill of regions beyond the sixteenth (slot 17 and up): neutral, told apart by the number chip only

data.which_set: by the canvas actually drawn, not by the window theme: the dark set on the default dark canvas (also in a light window), the light set only when Settings says 'canvas follows the theme' and the theme is light
data.validated_by: dataviz validate_palette.py --pairs all (any two regions can touch). Dark set vs #181A1E: lightness band PASS, chroma PASS, normal-vision floor 15.8 PASS, colour-blind separation worst 6.7 (deutan, #2A7D40 vs #C83220) = WARN band (legal only with a second cue: number chip + legend), contrast vs canvas relief on 2 slots (2.95, 2.90). Light set vs #F1EFF2: lightness PASS, chroma PASS, normal 18.4 PASS, colour-blind 8.8 PASS, contrast relief on 3 slots (2.05, 2.3, 1.97). The previous set (#0CA30C and #D95926 under deuteranopia: 1.4) FAILED --pairs all and is dropped.
data.known_clash: dark slot 6 (#C67294) is within dE 4.6 of the dark brand pink (#D96AA4; 2.4 for deuteranopes). A selected region is therefore never shown by accent colour alone: a 2 px outline in text colour plus the highlighted legend row.
data.fill_opacity_why: blended at alpha 0.45, 0.55 and 0.65 the dark set fails the normal-vision floor (11.1 to 14.3, needs 15); the light set fails at 0.45 and 0.55. Draw region fills opaque, mesh lines on top.

beyond_8.colour_follows: the entity (material, or region id when there is no material), by order of first appearance in the project, so filtering or reordering never repaints
beyond_8.slots_9_to_16: the same eight hues again, drawn with a hatch (1 px diagonal lines in the canvas ink colour, 6 px apart) over the solid fill; the number chip says which region it is
beyond_8.slots_17_plus: neutral grey fill with the number chip only; the legend collapses to 'N more' and the table view lists them

rules: One filled accent object per view (Compute). Selection is tint plus a 2 px accent bar.
Amber means time or attention (running, queued, stale) and nothing else.
Every state has a glyph and a word next to its colour.
No Color32 literal outside theme.rs and colormap.rs (test in the app crate).
Neutrals keep OKLCH chroma <= 0.026; the plum cast lives in text, accent and tint.
Colour is never the only channel: regions carry a number chip and a legend row, states a glyph and a word.
